data.body: Investigation: HIGH confidence. ROOT_CAUSE: _SYSTEM_PROMPT says 'severity (string)' with no enumeration — models use own vocabulary. No normalizer exists in pipeline. Fix: add 'severity (one of: critical, important, minor, fragile)' to _SYSTEM_PROMPT. Valid values confirmed from agent files + test_parity.py (4 values, not 3). Auto-approved. testing_mode=RED.
